Helmholtz-Zentrum HereonThe Helmholtz-Zentrum Hereon conducts cutting-edge international research for a changing world: Around 1,000 employees contribute to the tackling of climate change, the sustainable use of the world's coastal systems and the resource-compatible enhancement of the quality of life. From fundamental research to practical applications, the interdisciplinary research spectrum covers a unique range.

Institute of Metallic Biomaterials
In the Institute of Metallic Biomaterials new titanium and magnesium based implant materials for regenerative medicine are developed, produced and characterized. Researchers investigate the factors influencing the process chain and properties. In addition, the interaction of material and tissue is studied in the laboratory and at the synchrotron.

Postdoctoral Researcher - Agentic Correlative Image Analysis for BlueMaterials

JobID: 1058 - 2026/MB 3
Location: Rostock
Application deadline: 23 September, 2026

Join the Cluster of Excellence "BlueMat: Water-Driven Materials" ( www.tuhh.de/bluemat ) and collaborate with a dynamic, interdisciplinary team that combines science, sustainability, and technology to create a better future. Help shape the next generation of sustainable materials inspired by nature's most powerful resource: water.

For the Institute of Metallic Biomaterials, Helmholtz-Zentrum Hereon for as soon as possible, we are looking for a Postdoctoral Researcher - Agentic Correlative Image Analysis for BlueMaterials. In principle, the full time position (39 h/week) is also sharable. The position is fixed-term until 31 August 2029 and located in Rostock.

Equal opportunity is an important part of our personnel policy. We would therefore strongly encourage qualified women to apply for the position.

The BlueMat project 'Agentic correlative image analysis for BlueMaterials', bridges the different imaging and characterization techniques developed within the cross-area imaging and gives support to all researchers in the cluster of excellence to retrieve the highest quality information from image data. The project focusses on implementing an agentic framework for automation of correlative imaging and the corresponding image analysis in particular. By implementing LLM-driven agents that plan the analysis workflow, call established image-analysis modules and judge their own output, you will streamline image processing efforts and enable the elucidation of specific mechanisms of water-material interactions.

design and implement the agentic framework including task planning, tool use and function calling, and self-evaluation loops that orchestrate existing image-analysis modules
build a natural-language interface so BlueMat researchers can run correlative analyses without writing code
automate including image registration and enabling automated extraction of morphological features (e.g., porosity, tortuosity, connectivity) and fluid flow characteristics from 2D and 3D images resulting from magnetic resonance, X-ray and electron images
integration of motion analysis and digital volume correlation
processing of images in preparation for image-based modelling
individual support for researchers across BlueMat in solving image analysis challenges, especially segmentation and quantitative extraction

PhD in computer science, physics, materials science, applied mathematics or a related field
experience in building LLM-based agent systems
strong background in image processing and analysis, including deep learning
experience with correlative imaging workflows and 2D/3D registration techniques
strong programming skills in Python and/or C/C++
ability to work independently and collaboratively in an interdisciplinary environment
excellent communication skills in English
proven project management skills are highly desirable
willingness to travel regularly between Rostock and Hamburg (DESY)

Content-related enquiries regarding this position can be directed to Prof. Dr....

If you are curious and ambitious about taking on this challenge, we encourage you to apply today!

jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support the Industrial Architecture Team, Airbus Operations is looking for a

Working student (d/f/m) for Industrial Architecture

You are a full time student, looking for a working student position and want to get to know the work of an Industrial Architect?  Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in department designation as a working student (d/f/m) with approx. 18 hours a week!

At Airbus, Industrial Architecture is driving the next evolution of flight. We are looking for a collaborative, forward-thinking student to join us in shaping the industrial system for our next-generation single-aisle aircraft. If you are passionate about innovation, teamwork, and making a real-world impact, we would love to welcome you to our team.

- Location: Hamburg
- Start: 01.11.2026
- Duration:  12 months

You will receive a collectively agreed salary of at least €18.53 per hour, depending on the job. There are also special payments such as vacation pay.

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location: Hamburg Finkenwerder

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Are you wondering how you actually get from university to Airbus? Your working student position is at the Finkenwerder plant and you can take the ferry from Teufelsbrück to the Airbus ferry terminal and back to the university in the morning and at noon. Alternatively, you can take the ferry to Finkenwerder and then ride your bike for about another 15 minutes to the main entrance.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 18-hour week (flexitime).
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your Mission

You will play a vital role in supporting our team and management as we design the most efficient, sustainable, and innovative industrial system for the next Airbus aircraft.

How You Will Make an Impact:

- Coordinate & Align: Help keep our international teams connected and on track by co-creating and managing progress updates across time, cost, and quality.
- Encourage Fresh Perspectives: Bring your unique curiosity to the table. We value open dialogue and encourage you to constructively question the "status quo" to help us discover creative, innovative paths forward.
- Foster Connection: Support the organization and execution of collaborative events that bring our management and transnational teams together.

The Team

You will join a diverse, supportive, and highly collaborative network of Airbus industrial architects across Germany, France, and Spain, alongside our external partners. We pride ourselves on a culture of mutual respect, learning, and cross-border cooperation.

Your tasks and responsibilities

● Support the industrial architecture team in various projects, including data analysis, process optimization, and documentation.

● Assist in the development and implementation of architectural concepts and solutions for industrial facilities.

● Conduct research and gather information to support project requirements.

● Prepare presentations and reports for internal stakeholders.

● Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure project success.

Desired skills and qualifications

● Enrolled full-time student in the area of Industrial Economics, Industrial Engineering, Aircraft Design,architecture, mechanical engineering, computer science or an equivalent field of study.

● Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

● Are a natural communicator who enjoys building relationships and thrives in multicultural environments.

● Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Bring an open mindset, a collaborative spirit, and a passion for teamwork.

● Fluency in English (written and spoken), knowledge of German is a plus.

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

Company Description

Continental is a leading tire manufacturer and industry specialist. Founded in 1871, the company generated sales of €19.7 billion in 2025 and currently employs around 78,000 people in 54 countries and markets.

ContiTech is one of the world’s leading material experts for industry applications. The Continental group sector offers its customers reliable, safe and convenient industry and service solutions using a range of materials for off-highway applications, on rails and roads, in the air, under and above the ground, in industrial environments, for the food sector and the furniture industry. With about 20,000 employees (Status as of March 2026) at more than 60 sites globally, and sales of some 6.0 billion euros (2025), the global industrial partner is active with core branches in Asia, Europe and North and South America.

Job Description

We're looking for a motivated Antitrust Compliance Specialist (m/f/diverse) who is passionate about antitrust compliance and eager to contribute to global initiatives, foster knowledge sharing, and support the ongoing development of our compliance framework.

Your tasks will include the following activities:

- Taking an active role in enhancing and continuously improving ContiTech’s compliance program, particularly with respect to antitrust compliance
- Identifying opportunities to further strengthen the antitrust compliance program through active collaboration and communication with the regions
- Enhancing the concept for association activities and serving as the point of contact for related inquiries from all stakeholders
- Further developing the global antitrust risk assessment process and acting as the point of contact for antitrust-related questions
- Drafting, reviewing, and updating group policies and guidelines related to antitrust compliance
- Managing the rollout of global antitrust initiatives
- Developing content for antitrust training and other preventive measures in close collaboration with relevant departments
- Delivering antitrust training to all ContiTech business areas and central functions
- Designing and implementing additional mitigation measures, such as internal controls and monitoring activities
- Leading lessons-learned projects and driving ongoing improvements to the effectiveness of the antitrust Compliance Management System (CMS)
- Monitoring regulatory developments, best practices, industry trends, and compliance-related topics
- Developing and maintaining a knowledge-sharing concept for antitrust compliance, ensuring that all materials remain relevant and up to date
- Responding to external third-party audits of the ContiTech compliance program

Qualifications

- Qualification as a fully qualified lawyer (First and Second State Examination) is required
- Several years of professional experience in antitrust law and/or compliance, preferably gained in an international company, law firm, or auditing firm
- Additional experience in anti-money laundering (AML) is considered an advantage
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications
- Business-fluent German and English language skills, both written and spoken; additional language skills are a plus
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills combined with a collaborative and team-oriented mindset
- Strong intercultural competence and experience working across functions and international corporate structures
- Independent, structured, and solution-oriented working style
- Willingness to travel internationally

Applications from severely handicapped people are welcome.

Additional Information

The well-being of our employees is important to us. That's why we offer exciting career prospects and support you in achieving a good work-life balance with additional benefits such as:

- Training opportunities
- Mobile and flexible working models
- Sabbaticals

and much more...

jobs.occupation: Quality Conformance Manager (d/f/m) - First Article & Source Inspection (Qualitätskontrolleur/in)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

We are looking for a Quality Conformance Manager (d/f/m) to join our team. In this role, you act as the "quality wall" directly at our supplier locations to secure product conformity and ensure that all components strictly adhere to our design specifications and safety requirements. If you enjoy hands-on quality assurance, working closely with international suppliers and are ready for extensive travel across key production sites, this is the right opportunity for you.

Your location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Note on travel requirements: This role requires extensive international travel for the majority of the year to different supplier locations for short periods (approx. 35 weeks per year, typically in short 1-week trips).

Your benefits

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Act as the accountable quality wall at the supplier side to secure product conformity and ensure safe operation documentation for all cabin parts and cargo work packages released to Final Assembly Lines (FAL), manufacturing plants, and customers
- Plan and execute First Article Inspection (FAI) checks by witnessing supplier FAIs for new cabin and cargo components, ensuring engineering design and specification requirements are correctly understood, verified, and recorded
- Verify supplier FAI readiness upon invitation by checking required FAI documentation, questionnaires, and engineering design review results prior to on-site visits
- Perform Source Inspections (SI) and FAI buy-backs at supplier facilities on special request (e.g., in cases of decreasing quality performance or high customer expectations), occasionally in joint visits with airline customers
- Consult with Engineering departments for technical verification when required, ensuring reproducibility and maintenance of acceptable quality standards for consecutive production parts
- Provide objective evidence, key observations, and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) based on AS/EN/JISQ9102 standard checks to internal interface teams and project departments

Your boarding pass

- University degree in Engineering (Aerospace, Mechanical, or Manufacturing Engineering), Quality Management or a completed qualification as a State-Certified Technician / Master Craftsman (Techniker / Meister) in a relevant technical field
- Initial experience in quality assurance, quality inspection or supplier quality management, ideally within the aerospace or high-tech manufacturing sector
- Solid understanding of quality inspection methods and standard aviation frameworks (familiarity with AS/EN/JISQ9102 FAI standards is a strong asset)
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills to act assertively yet diplomatically as an Airbus quality representative towards external suppliers
- Negotiation level in English; German would be a strong plus
- High flexibility and willingness for extensive international travel (approx. 35 weeks per year, typically in short 1-week trips)

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

Disabled applicants will be given preference in case of equal qualification.

Ready for take-off?

Apply now with your resume, salary expectations and notice period to take your career to the next level!

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

The GWDG is seeking a

Quantum Computing Expert (m/f/d)

to join an interdisciplinary team of HPC experts in the working group “Computing” (AG C), full-time (39 hours perweek), remunerated in accordance with TVöD E 13. The position is tied to the GWDG QC project’s runtime running tillOctober 2029. The successful candidate is expected to contribute in developing GWDG’s QC ecosystem (seeresponsibilities listed below). The GWDG handles sensitive data, and in such cases, it is important that the code ishuman-verified for any security concerns. The applicant must demonstrate the ability to do such a verification withoutAI assistance in the interview.

The Gesellschaft für wissenschaftliche Datenverarbeitung mbH Göttingen (GWDG) is the university computing centerfor the Georg-August-Universität Göttingen and a computing and IT competence center for the Max Planck Society.The provision of high-performance HPC systems has been one of its tasks for over 40 years. In 2020, the Universityof Göttingen / GWDG was accepted as one of eight computing centers (NHR-Nord@Göttingen) in the National High-Performance Computing (NHR) network. The GWDG also operates the national AI service center KISSKI and is apartner in the EU AI Factory HammerHAI. Furthermore, the GWDG operates HPC resources for the GermanAerospace Center (DLR). As a national supercomputing center, the GWDG provides technical support to researchersand students from various scientific domains, including digital humanities, life science, earth system science, andengineering. We also participate in both national and international research projects. In the field of quantumcomputing, the GWDG also runs the QUICS project, providing SMEs with access to quantum computing resources.

We are looking for highly motivated candidates to join the QC team at the GWDG focused on anomaly detection forindustry applications. The goal is to build a platform for such use cases based on existing stacks, giving companies atool for quantum anomaly detection.

The GWDG together with the Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science and the Campus Institute Data Science(CIDAS) of the University of Göttingen provides a stimulating research environment in Scientific Computing, with anopportunity to conduct research in the intersection of applied computer science, High-Performance Computing,Quantum Computing, and AI.

Responsibilities

Focus:

Integration of quantum-based algorithms into classical computing environments, and system-levelstability/error analysis of the integrated hybrid stack.

The role goes beyond merely operating existing quantum software stacks. It also involves designing modular,hardware-agnostic backends capable of seamlessly integrating both simulators and current NISQ devices. Thisrequires:

Running simulations on HPC systems, including efficiently parallelizing computational tasks

Writing HPC-executable, production-ready code

Ensuring scalability and robustness of algorithms in large-scale environments

Identifying and resolving error sources in the integrated hybrid stack, particularly cascading errors acrossmodules

Developing independent code for simulations, extending beyond the use of standard software libraries

Requirements

PhD and/or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Physics, or a related field, combined with demonstrableindustry or research experience

Proven coding experience (without AI assistance): scope, functions, variables, classes, array methods, etc.

Good knowledge of diverse quantum hardware, error correction/mitigation strategies, and respective SDKecosystems (Qiskit, Cirq, Braket, Qrisp, AutoQML, etc.)

Advanced linear algebra knowledge: matrix diagonalization methods, magnus expansion, Zassenhausformula, group theory

Advanced quantum physics knowledge: quantum circuit design, Trotterization, quantum machine learning, etc

Demonstrated experience running simulations on HPC systems

Excellent teamwork and communication skills

Fluent English (spoken and written)

Do you fit all the above requirements? Then we welcome your application!

Desirable

Hands-on experience with multiple quantum SDKs (Qiskit, Cirq, Amazon Braket, PennyLane)

Experience implementing or working with quantum error mitigation/correction techniques

Experience running large-scale quantum simulations on HPC clusters (e.g., GPU-accelerated state-vector ortensor-network simulators)

Contributions to open-source quantum computing libraries, or published work on quantum algorithms

Familiarity with ion-trap or other NISQ hardware platforms

Knowledge in writing bash scripts for HPC job submission

German B2 or higher

Our offer

Flexible working hours and opportunity for partial mobile working

A modern, diverse work environment at the intersection between academia and industry

An interesting, versatile job in a large, internationally operating IT competence center

Qualification and further development of your skills

Social benefits of the public sector

Your application

Have we sparked your interest? Then please send us your application by 30.09.2026 via our online form:

https://bewerbermanagement.net/67hhg

jancillie.louw@gwdg.de ).

jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support Final Assembly Line (FAL) Hamburg Transformation Train, Airbus is looking for a

Procure & Supply Product Owner (d/f/m)

The ARP (Airbus Resources Planning) Program is a cornerstone of Airbus's digital transformation, optimizing industrial processes and flows globally. You will join our dynamic, international team working in Multi-Functional Teams (MFT) under the SAFe/Agile framework to drive solution delivery and business transformation. In this role, you will lead delivery for the Agile Procure and Supply MFT while driving key digital implementation across FAL Hamburg.

This role is also available with reduced weekly hours and an adapted scope of tasks.

Your location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Your Benefits

- Attractive salary and special payments
- 30 days paid vacation and extra days-off for special occasions
- Excellent upskilling opportunities and great international, group wide development prospects
- Special benefits: employer-funded pension, employee stock options, discounted car leasing, special conditions for insurances, transportation subsidy, employee benefits at cooperating companies
- On-site-facilities: Kindergarten close to the site, medical officer for check-ups and other health-related services, canteen and cafeteria
- Compatibility of family & work (job sharing, part-time models, flexible working hours, individual timeout)
- Working in a diverse environment, with more than 140 nationalities, where every voice is heard

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Drive the delivery of the Agile Procure and Supply MFT and manage interfaces with other MFTs inside and outside the FAL Hamburg train.
- Enable efficient implementation of new processes and digital tools aligned with SAP standards and global end-to-end Supply Chain strategies.
- Analyze complex operational needs through in-depth analysis and workshops with customers in a cross-functional, transnational context.
- Collaborate closely with customers from early discovery through to hypercare following entry into service.
- Translate complex data into clear documentation and visualizations to drive stakeholder buy-in and alignment.
- Contribute to the elaboration of deployment strategies and method refinement for the Transformation Train.
- Lead pioneering projects integrating emerging technologies with SAP solutions as required.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Educational background in Business Administration, Engineering, Supply Chain, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
- 8+ years of experience in Aerospace or complex industries (e.g., Automotive, Defence) with deep Procure & Supply business knowledge.
- Proficiency in SAP modules (MM, PP, QM, EWM) and solid understanding of SAFe/Agile methodologies and Project Management.
- Strong stakeholder management, negotiation, change management, and leadership skills in multi-functional, international settings.
- Excellent communication and data visualization skills, with an advanced level of English (German skills and willingness to travel max. once per month are a plus).

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions. Please include your starting date and salary expectations in your application and apply in English.

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

jobs.occupation: Senior Logistics Coordinator & Import/Export Analyst (m/f/d) (Fachkraft - Logistik/Materialwirtschaft)
jobs.description:
At Azenta Life Sciences, we support some of the world's leading pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and research organizations by managing the samples and materials that underpin scientific discovery.

Join our Griesheim Biobank team as EU Sample Management Coordinator (Logistics Coordinator & Import/Export Analyst).

How You´ll Add Value

As EU Sample Management Coordinator (m/w/d), you will coordinate the shipment of biological samples, laboratory materials, and related goods throughout Europe and internationally. In this role, you will also help ensure compliance with applicable customs, import/export, and trade regulations by supporting the accurate preparation, review, and coordination of shipment documentation and related processes.

The role offers a combination of hands-on logistics coordination, customs administration, customer communication, and process improvement. Success in this position requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while ensuring shipments meet internal standards and external regulatory requirements.

This is an opportunity to join an established international organization and play a key role in supporting scientific and clinical research projects across Europe.

What You´ll Do

- You are part of a four-person logistics team that serves as the central point of contact for logistics matters across our operations, as well as for customers and service providers.
- You coordinate and manage shipping orders in day-to-day operations, ensuring timely, accurate, and compliant execution.
- Your routine tasks include packaging and labeling goods ready for shipment, as well as preparing cover letters, freight documents, and customs documentation.
- You support import and export compliance activities, including reviewing shipment data for customs relevance, helping ensure correct classification, documentation completeness, and adherence to internal procedures and applicable regulations.
- You are responsible for coordinating with customs authorities, brokers, and other relevant parties to ensure smooth border crossings, including in time-critical cases.
- You help monitor and maintain records related to import/export activities and support internal compliance checks, audits, and process documentation updates where required.
- You support the continuous development of our logistics processes and service offerings, including with a focus on compliance, efficiency, and sustainability.
- You also support incoming goods processing when needed, checking for completeness and informing the relevant departments, for example in the case of deliveries of chemicals and reagents.
- Additionally, you are responsible for inventory, as well as managing and ordering logistics-related materials.
- You understand and strictly adhere to standard operating procedures (SOPs) in English and contribute to maintaining high ethical and quality standards in all shipment-related activities.

What You´ll Bring

- Successfully completed vocational training or a degree in business administration, logistics, customs, or a similar qualification.
- Practical work experience in logistics, customs, import/export, or within a freight forwarding company.
- Sound understanding of customs clearance processes, shipping documentation, and import/export compliance requirements; experience with dangerous goods is a plus.
- Familiarity with trade compliance topics such as tariff classification, country of origin, customs value, restricted party screening, or license-related checks is an advantage.
- Very good communication skills, both written and verbal.
- Reliability clearance in accordance with Section 7 of the German Aviation Security Act (LuftSiG).
- Team player with enthusiasm for working in an international team.
- Proficient in standard MS Office software; advanced Excel skills and familiarity with ERP systems are an advantage.
- Forward-thinking and solution-oriented approach to work, with a strong awareness of compliance and best practices.
- Strong hands-on mentality.
- Attention to detail and excellent prioritization skills.
- Fluent in German and English (B2 level or higher).

What We Offer

- Become part of a company that contributes to groundbreaking scientific developments and therapies.
- Positive company culture and strong teamwork across all locations.
- Individual development opportunities to strengthen your international competencies and language skills.
- Attractive workplace in Griesheim with excellent transport connections.
- 30 days of annual leave to support a healthy work-life balance.
- Partnership with pme Familienservice to support employees in all life situations.
- Additional benefits include a stock purchase program, life insurance, company pension scheme, profit sharing, five additional childcare sick days, and a corporate benefits online shopping platform.
